verdict.rationale: Alma's O-1A startup-founders guide says a U.S. company you own or founded can petition for you if a valid employer-employee relationship exists. It also covers control arrangements: solo founders without an independent board can use an authorized U.S. Agent as petitioner, and proper entity structuring helps avoid RFEs on ownership control. The evidence never references the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance or explains beneficial-ownership rules in detail, and its coverage is limited to O-1A (the IER explainer is a separate pathway). Missing for 10: explicit coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder/entrepreneur guidance, detailed beneficial-ownership rules, founder self-petition mechanics for H-1B and other visa types, and independent corroboration.
